mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zw_score (EXAM_ID, STUDENT_ID, SCORE) VALUES (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.EXAM_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.SCORE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, st.STUDENT_CODE, st.GRA, st.CLA, u.NAME FROM zw_score s LEFT JOIN g_exam e ON s.EXAM_ID = e.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st ON s.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID LEFT JOIN g_user u ON st.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE s.SCORE_ID = #{scoreId}

SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.EXAM_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.SCORE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, e.EXAM_TIME, st.STUDENT_CODE, st.GRA, st.CLA, u.NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.CLA = st.CLA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as CLASS_RANK, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.GRA = st.GRA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as GRADE_RANK FROM zw_score s LEFT JOIN g_exam e ON s.EXAM_ID = e.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st ON s.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID LEFT JOIN g_user u ON st.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC, s.SCORE_ID

SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.EXAM_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.SCORE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, e.EXAM_TIME, st.STUDENT_CODE, st.GRA, st.CLA, u.NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.CLA = st.CLA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as CLASS_RANK, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.GRA = st.GRA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as GRADE_RANK FROM zw_score s LEFT JOIN g_exam e ON s.EXAM_ID = e.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st ON s.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID LEFT JOIN g_user u ON st.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE s.EXAM_ID = #{examId} ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC, s.SCORE_ID

SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.EXAM_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.SCORE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, e.EXAM_TIME, st.STUDENT_CODE, st.GRA, st.CLA, u.NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.CLA = st.CLA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as CLASS_RANK, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.GRA = st.GRA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as GRADE_RANK FROM zw_score s LEFT JOIN g_exam e ON s.EXAM_ID = e.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st ON s.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID LEFT JOIN g_user u ON st.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE s.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC

SELECT s.SCORE_ID, s.EXAM_ID, s.STUDENT_ID, s.SCORE, e.EXAM_NAME, e.SUBJECT_TYPE, sub.CODE_DESC as SUBJECT_TYPE_DESC, e.EXAM_TIME, st.STUDENT_CODE, st.GRA, st.CLA, u.NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.CLA = st.CLA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as CLASS_RANK, (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM zw_score s2 LEFT JOIN g_exam e2 ON s2.EXAM_ID = e2.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st2 ON s2.STUDENT_ID = st2.STUDENT_ID WHERE s2.EXAM_ID = s.EXAM_ID AND e2.SUBJECT_TYPE = e.SUBJECT_TYPE AND st2.GRA = st.GRA AND s2.SCORE > s.SCORE) as GRADE_RANK FROM zw_score s LEFT JOIN g_exam e ON s.EXAM_ID = e.EXAM_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sub ON e.SUBJECT_TYPE = sub.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN zw_student st ON s.STUDENT_ID = st.STUDENT_ID LEFT JOIN g_user u ON st.USER_ID = u.USER_ID
AND e.SUBJECT_TYPE = #{param1}
AND e.EXAM_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param2}, '%')
ORDER BY e.EXAM_TIME DESC, s.SCORE_ID
